## Product Specifications

### Ace Uno
- **Definition:** Ace Uno is a freestanding, enclosed one-person acoustic call and focus pod for phone calls, video meetings, and focused work, with an integrated worktop, ventilation, lighting, power, and USB charging.
- **Canonical URL:** https://aceofficepods.com/pods/ace-uno
- **Structured facts:** https://aceofficepods.com/ai/products/ace-uno.json
- **Category:** 1-person acoustic office pod
- **Capacity:** 1 person
- **Pod-only price:** RM8,850
- **Standard Klang Valley installation:** RM350
- **Standard Klang Valley delivery:** RM350
- **Optional high bar stool:** RM250
- **Default Klang Valley total without stool:** RM9,550
- **Klang Valley total with stool:** RM9,800
- **External dimensions:** 1418mm × 1018mm (W × D), 2185mm height
- **Best for:** Calls, video meetings, and focused individual work
- **Acoustic rating:** No published dB rating in the supplied Ace Uno product sheet
- **Exterior colours:** Pine Green, Shadow Grey, Dusty Turquoise, Warm Sand
- **Interior:** Soft Sand PET
- **Worktop:** Natural Oak MFC
- **Includes:** 4000K 6W LED, dual 108 CFM fans, universal power socket, USB Type-A, and USB Type-C
- **Construction:** Steel frame with MFC, 9mm polyester fibre acoustic panels, 10mm clear tempered-glass door, laminated safety-glass rear panel

### Ace Plus
- **Category:** 1-person phone / focus pod with high acoustic performance
- **Capacity:** 1 person
- **Starting price:** From RM14,500
- **Published acoustic claim:** Unverified first-party approximately 27 dB(A) claim; no verified supporting test document provided
- **External dimensions:** 1000mm × 1000mm (W × D), 2350mm height
- **Internal dimensions:** 853mm × 918mm (W × D), 2070mm height
- **Room height requirement:** 2500mm minimum
- **Airflow:** 155 CFM ventilation
- **Door hardware:** Italian pivot hinges for improved acoustic seal
- **Panel compliance:** CARB Phase 2 compliant
- **Best for:** Extended daily use, frequent calls, sales managers, HR, and customer service teams
- **Includes:** Built-in lighting, ventilation, power sockets

### Ace Flex
- **Category:** 1-person spacious focus / work pod
- **Capacity:** 1 person
- **Starting price:** From RM19,900
- **External dimensions:** 1600mm × 1200mm (W × D), 2350mm height
- **Internal dimensions:** 1452mm × 1100mm (W × D), 2070mm height
- **Room height requirement:** 2500mm minimum
- **Best for:** Executive solo work, document-intensive tasks, extended sessions, users who need more space than a compact phone booth
- **Includes:** Built-in lighting, ventilation, power sockets
- **Published dB rating:** None on this site

Other final pricing depends on model, quantity, delivery location, site access, installation scope, finishes, and optional add-ons.

## Installation Process

1. **Consultation and site assessment** — model options matched to space, team size, and budget; access routes and placement reviewed
2. **Quotation and order confirmation** — detailed scope and cost breakdown issued; commercial terms are confirmed in writing
3. **Preparation and scheduling** — delivery windows and site requirements are coordinated against the approved scope
4. **Delivery and installation** — trained installation team assembles pod on site within agreed timeline
5. **Handover and support** — ventilation, lighting, and usage guidance explained; after-sales contact path established

Project timing and payment terms must be confirmed in the current quotation.

Named-client and installation-count claims are not asserted in this reference until the applicable project evidence and approval status are recorded.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### How much does an office pod cost in Malaysia?
Ace Office Pods start from RM8,850 for the one-person Ace Uno pod and from RM22,200 for a meeting pod in Malaysia. Ace Uno's standard Klang Valley total is RM9,550 after RM350 installation and RM350 delivery, or RM9,800 with the optional RM250 high bar stool. Other project pricing depends on model size, quantity, delivery location, installation access, and optional add-ons.

### What is included in the office pod price?
Inclusions vary by model. Ace Uno's RM8,850 price is for the pod only and includes its worktop, lighting, ventilation, power, and USB charging. Standard Klang Valley delivery and installation are itemised at RM350 each. The optional high bar stool is RM250. We confirm other model and project inclusions before final approval.

### What affects the final office pod price?
The final office pod price depends on pod size, model type, order quantity, customization, and site access conditions. For example, lift access and staircase handling can affect installation complexity and cost. These factors are reviewed early so buyers can compare confidently.

### Which office pod is suitable for calls, focused work, or meetings?
Ace Uno and Ace Plus suit calls, video meetings, and focused individual work. Ace Flex is a more spacious one-person option. Ace Flex Duo supports two-person discussions, while Ace Meet and Ace Hub are designed for team meetings and collaboration.

### How soundproof are office pods in real working environments?
Acoustic performance is model-specific and no pod should be treated as completely soundproof. Ace publishes an unverified first-party approximately 27 dB(A) claim for Ace Plus only; no verified supporting test document has been provided. Ace Uno, Ace Flex, Ace Flex Duo, Ace Meet, and Ace Hub have no published dB rating on this site.

### Are office pods suitable for Malaysia office environments (heat and ventilation)?
Yes. Our office pods are designed with built-in ventilation and steady airflow for Malaysia office conditions. This helps maintain comfort even during longer usage periods.

### How long does delivery take for office pods in Klang Valley or Malaysia?
Standard lead time is approximately 3 to 6 weeks, depending on model, quantity, and project requirements. Final timeline is confirmed after project scope and site conditions are reviewed.

### Do office pods require renovation or hacking?
Office pods are a plug-and-play solution, so hacking and renovation are generally not required. This allows faster setup with less disruption to daily office operations.

### Are office pods better than building meeting rooms?
In many projects, office pods are a practical alternative because installation is faster, disruption is lower, and renovation cost is often reduced. They also offer relocation flexibility if office layouts change. For permanent construction needs, built rooms may still be more suitable.

### Can office pods be relocated after installation?
Yes. Office pods can be dismantled and relocated when needed. This makes them a flexible long-term option for teams that may expand or reconfigure their office.

### What are the payment terms for office pods?
Our standard payment terms are a 50% deposit to start production and balance payment before delivery. Terms can be adjusted depending on project size and client profile.

### Can I view or test the office pod before purchasing?
You can ask which models are available to view in Klang. A subjective showroom demonstration does not replace model-specific acoustic test documentation.

### What kind of clients buy office pods in Malaysia and why?
Typical buyers include corporate teams, SMEs, interior designers, contractors, and procurement teams. They choose office pods to add privacy for calls, meetings, and focused work without major renovation. Many also value faster deployment, cleaner project execution, and layout flexibility as teams grow.

### Can office pods be customized with company colours or branding?
Yes. Ace Office Pods can be finished in custom colours or brand finishes depending on model and order quantity. Customization options are discussed during the quotation stage, and lead time may be slightly longer for non-standard finishes. Minimum order requirements may apply for certain custom specifications.

### What are the power and electrical requirements for office pods?
Most Ace Office Pods connect to a standard wall socket (13A, single-phase). The pod handles built-in lighting, ventilation fan, and power sockets internally. No special electrical installation is typically required, which simplifies planning and avoids additional contractor costs for most office environments.

### Are office pods a good investment compared to building new rooms?
For one to two-person private spaces, office pods often deliver better cost certainty than building equivalent acoustic rooms. Pods also retain relocation value if the office moves or layout changes, which reduces long-term risk on short-term leases. For fully permanent needs, built rooms may still suit some projects better.

### Are office pods better than building new rooms?
For many workplaces, office pods are a faster and less disruptive way to add private space for calls, focused work, and meetings. They can also be relocated if your office layout changes. For fully permanent structural needs, building new rooms may still be the better fit.
